notes: §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR7: 'The NO REWIND phrase must only be used with' sequential single reel/unit files or files on one reel of a multiple file tape, and GR8 ignores it where it 'does not apply to the storage medium'. A report file is sequential; CheckOpenTapePhrase and OpenTapePhraseRule admit NO REWIND only with OUTPUT (EXTEND is COBOL1803, REVERSED COBOL2211, a doubled phrase COBOL2269), and FileRegistry.NoRewindPhraseEffect overlays 07, the 1985 status for a non-reel/unit medium. Probes at 85: NO REWIND with and without WITH, and on a multiple-file-tape member, give 07, and an unphrased sibling 00; OPEN WITH LOCK and SHARING are refused. Witness: OPEN SUCCESSFUL, GENERATED, CLOSE 00.

next.reason: 1985: 'The NO REWIND phrase must only be used with: a. Sequential single reel/unit files ... b. Sequential files wholly contained within a single reel of tape within a multiple file tape environment.' 2023 keeps only 'The NO REWIND phrase may be specified only for sequential files' (§2023:14.9.27.3 SR5); no 2023 rule limits it to single-unit files, so NO REWIND on a multi-unit sequential file becomes allowed. Looser.
